decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records that historical NFT reward attributes need not be backfilled while future reward-attribute accuracy remains required.
Waiving backfill of historical no-code reward entries does not change NFT transfer semantics or the recipient of future commissions after transfer.
The source context concerns historical entries on the leaderboard and in NFT attributes, not a relaxation of the dashboard display requirement.
The source decision does not revise any About-page copy or product-mechanics description represented by this requirement.
The source specifically relaxes historical backfill for leaderboard and NFT-attribute records and does not change the accuracy requirement for the frontend NFT detail view.
Historical no-code ticket and commission backfill does not affect mint totals, prize-pool values, top-referral statistics, or the next-draw counter.
The decision about historical reward accounting does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear on the dashboard.
The source does not change fiat-buyer wallet provisioning, dashboard access, or prospective access to commissions, tickets, and prizes.
The source preserves correct future no-code commission allocation and only waives remediation of missing historical records; it does not alter the allocation trigger, amount, or recipient selection.
The approved FAQ state contains no historical-backfill promise that must be revised by this decision.
Historical reward-entry backfill is unrelated to displaying NFT images, metadata, or book covers in wallets and product views.
The source does not change Small Block ticket generation, eligibility, draw execution, prize funding, or winner selection; it only waives historical display/accounting backfill.
